title: Finite radicial spectrum map adjoining a characteristic-p root
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring of prime characteristic $p$ and $a\in A$. The canonical morphism $\operatorname{Spec}(A[T]/(T^p-a))\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is finite, surjective and universally injective [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-polynomial-ring] [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] [def-weil-radicial-morphism]. Neither reducedness nor a domain or nontriviality assumption on $A$ is required.

proof.text: T^p-a is monic of positive degree. Its root algebra is finite free, hence faithfully flat over A. Apply the finite affine spectrum criterion and the faithfully-flat spectrum criterion to obtain finiteness and surjectivity. The zero-ring case is included.

For universal injectivity use the field-point criterion. Two points Spec Ω→Spec(A[T]/(T^p-a)) over the same A-point induce ring homomorphisms alpha,beta agreeing on A. Their target field has characteristic p. The images of the adjoined root have equal p-th powers, so injectivity of Frobenius makes them equal. Extensionality for the root algebra then gives alpha=beta and equality of the scheme points.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_radicial_root_cover (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) [CharP A p] (a : A) :
    let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap A (AdjoinRoot (X ^ p - C a : A[X]))))
    IsFinite g ∧ Surjective g ∧ UniversallyInjective g
